bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/media/capture.rs, springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (audio service records WAV; no recognizer)
summary: The Speech framework does speech-to-text on live or recorded audio. BifrOSt has no recognizer, no transcription module and no SDK API for it. The audio service can record microphone audio to WAV on explicit user request, which a recognizer could later consume. The keyboard's dictation key is a glyph that does nothing when tapped.

features.feature: Speech recognition on live or recorded audio (framework overview)
features.apple: Speech (collection); SpeechAnalyzer, SpeechTranscriber, DictationTranscriber, SpeechDetector, SpeechModule
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (speech_recognizer.rs, recognition.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. No transcription anywhere in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src. Apple's SpeechAnalyzer and module classes have no counterpart. Built 2026-10-17: on-device recognition through the gst-plugin-whisper element: the pipeline argv and transcript parser (bifrost_ui::whisper; tests whisper::tests), the shell service speech_recognizer (shell::services::recognizer::tests) and the SDK client and backend (bifrost_app speech_whisper::tests). Recognition needs the model, which the person downloads after consent in Settings, Keyboard, Dictation. Audio never leaves the machine. Not yet run on Midget.

features.apple: Speech Recognition in Objective-C (SFSpeechRecognizer and related classes)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/speech_recognizer.rs (SFSpeechRecognizer, SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest, SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest, SFSpeechRecognitionTask, SFSpeechRecognitionResult, SFTranscription, SFTranscriptionSegment)
features.note: Host unit tests with a fake backend: authorization, availability, partial then final results, segment timing, cancel. No real recognition engine yet (backend trait only); not tested on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: WhisperBackend implements RecognitionBackend over the shell transcripts, so SFSpeechRecognizer tasks get whisper results (bifrost_app speech_whisper::tests). The on-device engine is now the whisper element; the model download is required.

gaps: No speech recognizer or transcription module (SpeechAnalyzer, SpeechTranscriber, DictationTranscriber) in the SDK, the UI kit or the shell.
No SDK API that streams time-coded microphone audio to an app, so a recognizer cannot be fed from an app.
No recognition result type with alternatives, confidence or time ranges.
No custom vocabulary or contextual strings for recognition.
No on-device speech model install or inventory path.
Keyboard Mic key is inert; system dictation is missing.
No app-facing microphone permission prompt. The audio service records only on an explicit user action (springboard/proto/src/svc.rs:218).
